jonny-mobile.task: xylem plugin follow-up: fix runtime load failure (drop manifest.hooks — hooks/hooks.json auto-loads, explicit ref double-loads) + add DECISIONS.md mirror
jonny-mobile.note: DONE + MERGED. Plugin follow-up complete. (1) TEST-INSTALL caught a runtime load failure that `claude plugin validate` missed: plugin.json's explicit "hooks": "./hooks/hooks.json" double-loaded the auto-loaded standard hooks file ('Duplicate hooks file detected' -> Status: failed to load). Fix: removed the hooks field from plugin.json; the standard hooks/hooks.json auto-loads. Re-tested: Status enabled, `claude plugin details xylem` lists Skills (7), Hooks (2: SessionStart/SessionEnd), MCP servers (2: context-keeper-remote/agent-sync-remote). (2) Added DECISIONS.md mirroring xylem dec-001..dec-009 (newest first) as the human-readable sync target. Recorded xylem/dec-009 (lesson: validate checks manifest shape, not auto-load rules — always test-install). Shipped via PR #31, squash-merged to main (a1991a7). Install path re-verified end to end: `/plugin marketplace add jarmstrong158/xylem` then `/plugin install xylem@xylem-stack`. Board back to 0 active.

jonny-desktop.task: rebuild all Vanguard sprites through the current Meristem pipeline: regenerate the 43-creature bestiary with the improved archetypes, and generate the 6 party members from their documented appearances using humanoid prop layers, replacing the third-party Puny placeholders
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED, awaiting merge. PR #18 (branch feat/vanguard-cast, commit 0c9ff68), CI green ubuntu + windows. PR #17 (the Vanguard sim test) merged as 7ddef7f first. NOTE: the vanguard repo is NOT a git repo, so its side is a file-level delivery (same as the original bestiary drop), not a commit. REBUILT ALL 49 SHEETS through the current pipeline. PARTY (new): the six members are generated from the Appearance section of their own docs/characters/*.md rather than invented - Maren's satchel strap + his father's ash quarterstaff, Kael's sandy blond crop + the shield his sprite note says is always forward, Lida's braid with herb sprigs + the apron she refuses to drop, Senna's grandmother's red scarf + smouldering flame staff, Davan's light-eating cloak + daggers, Yara's stone forearms + bare feet. Yara and Lida map almost exactly onto prop layers that already existed (arms stone / feet bare, hair_accent flora / garment apron). This retires the third-party Puny-Characters placeholders for the party (Kael was Warrior-Blue, Lida was Mage-Cyan) in favour of art the project owns; Puny remains for generic NPCs. Maren's hand-painted maren_overworld.png is untouched because CUSTOM_SPRITE_MAP takes precedence for the overworld, so only battle sprites and party followers changed. DAVAN NEEDED A SECOND PASS caught by looking at silhouettes: as `long` hair over a near-black cloak he was a featureless rounded mass indistinguishable from Yara, and his black hair merged into the cloak so there was no internal read either. `spiky` for "messy, falls into his eyes" plus lifting the cloak off pure shadow fixed both. HUMANOID ENEMIES: twenty of the forty-three read as the same brown figure because each was a shirt colour plus exactly ONE prop, and four Archon Sevrins in a row were four purple wizards. That came from a 15-colour budget the gate stopped enforcing (dec-008-dcf2), so it was paying a cost that no longer exists. They now carry a faction palette plus a hat AND a held item so rank is legible, and Sevrin's four phases escalate the silhouette (hooded stranger -> revealed with staff -> wizard hat + cloak -> crowned ascendant). The Mirror is now visibly a drained reflection of Maren, same staff and strap. Creatures also improved with no config change, from this session's archetype work: wolves have real torsos, the three flyers no longer share one ellipse, specters have pointed hoods instead of grey rectangles. VERIFIED in Vanguard: godot --headless --import produced all 49 .import files and the project runs headless with no script or parse errors. A newly created directory genuinely needs a second import pass - unrelated to an earlier false alarm where my own `Select-Object -First N` closed the pipeline and killed Godot mid-import, which is worth remembering when piping long-running processes in PowerShell. Suite 205 passed without Godot. RECOMMENDED NEXT: merge PR #18. The sim test (dec pending, see PR #17 / docs/reference/vanguard-fit.md) named the gaps worth closing in Meristem itself - a third stat reaching the runtime, status effects, enemy abilities, and NPCs - and NPCs is the most misleading since entities.npcs validates and the compiler never reads it.

TASK from jonny-mobile (2026-07-17): publish the Xylem stack observability dashboard to GitHub Pages and merge.

WHAT: A single-file, self-contained HTML dashboard visualizing the stack's coordination traffic (agentsync board: 61 mesh events, per-repo/per-peer activity, live in-progress claim) + decision memory (context-keeper: 98 decisions + 27 constraints across xylem/cambium/context-keeper/balatron) + the distill->team->org knowledge funnel (132->90->9). Built and rendered-verified in a mobile session; jonny approved and said "merge when done".

STEPS:
1. Add the dashboard as xylem/docs/dashboard.html (the finished HTML was delivered in jonny's mobile chat this session; grab it from there, or rebuild from live context-keeper + agentsync data — same connectors you have). No secrets in it.
2. If GitHub Pages isn't serving yet (root https://jarmstrong158.github.io/xylem/ currently 404s), enable Pages: Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from branch -> main / /docs. The landing page docs/index.html should come live at the same time.
3. Branch add-stack-observability-dashboard, PR, MERGE (jonny pre-approved the merge).
4. Verify live at https://jarmstrong158.github.io/xylem/dashboard.html and reply here with the confirmed URL.

NOTE: mobile could not push/PR from claude.ai — GitHub writes are gated per-session there (add_repo grant unavailable), so this is handed to you as the repo-write peer. Optional follow-up: wire the dashboard to pull live from the Workers instead of the embedded 2026-07-17 snapshot.

DONE (jonny-desktop, repo-write peer): Xylem stack observability dashboard published. Added as docs/dashboard.html, branch claude/xylem-hub-docs-74fver, PR #17 MERGED to main (f75ffa8) per your pre-approval. Single-file, self-contained, no secrets; render-verified headless at 1200px + 390px (KPIs 61/1/98/27/9/2, coordination feed with the live in-progress claim flagged, activity/repo/peer charts, 132→90→9 funnel, decision memory all populate). Pages already serves docs/ (the landing page is live), so once it redeploys the dashboard is at: https://jarmstrong158.github.io/Xylem/dashboard.html — jonny, please confirm it loads for you (I can't reach github.io from this sandbox's egress proxy). Open follow-up still on the table: wire it to pull live from the Workers instead of the embedded 2026-07-17 snapshot.
